#### `AccordionPanel`

A panel with multiple collapsible sections.

Inherits `ContainerControl`. Implements `IBindableComponent`, `IComponent`, `IContainerControl`, `IDisposable`, `IDropTarget`, `ISynchronizeInvoke`, `IWin32Window`.

| Member | Signature | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `AccordionPanel` | `AccordionPanel()` | Initializes a new instance of the `AccordionPanel` class. |
| `AllowMultipleExpanded` | `bool AllowMultipleExpanded { get; set; }` | Gets or sets whether multiple sections can be expanded simultaneously. |
| `AnimateExpansion` | `bool AnimateExpansion { get; set; }` | Gets or sets whether to animate expansion. |
| `SectionHeight` | `int SectionHeight { get; set; }` | Gets or sets the default section height when expanded. |
| `Sections` | `AccordionSection[] Sections { get; }` | Gets the sections. |
| `AddSection` | `AccordionSection AddSection(string header)` | Adds a new section. |
| `ClearSections` | `void ClearSections()` | Removes all sections. |
| `CollapseAll` | `void CollapseAll()` | Collapses all sections. |
| `ExpandAll` | `void ExpandAll()` | Expands all sections. |
| `OnSectionCollapsed` | `protected virtual void OnSectionCollapsed(AccordionSectionEventArgs e)` | Raises the `SectionCollapsed` event. |
| `OnSectionExpanded` | `protected virtual void OnSectionExpanded(AccordionSectionEventArgs e)` | Raises the `SectionExpanded` event. |
| `RemoveSection` | `void RemoveSection(AccordionSection section)` | Removes a section. |
| `SectionCollapsed` | `event EventHandler<AccordionSectionEventArgs> SectionCollapsed` | Occurs when a section is collapsed. |
| `SectionExpanded` | `event EventHandler<AccordionSectionEventArgs> SectionExpanded` | Occurs when a section is expanded. |

```csharp
var accordion = new AccordionPanel {
  AllowMultipleExpanded = false
};
var section1 = accordion.AddSection("Section 1");
section1.ContentPanel.Controls.Add(new Label { Text = "Content 1" });
var section2 = accordion.AddSection("Section 2");
section2.ContentPanel.Controls.Add(new Label { Text = "Content 2" });
```

#### `DataGridViewButtonColumnAttribute`

Allows specifying a `String` or `Image` property to be used as a button column.

Inherits `Attribute`.

| Member | Signature | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `DataGridViewButtonColumnAttribute` | `DataGridViewButtonColumnAttribute(string onClickMethodName, string isEnabledWhenPropertyName = null)` | Allows specifying a `String` or `Image` property to be used as a button column. |

```csharp
// Define a custom type for the data grid view rows
public class DataRow
{
    public int Id { get; set; }
    public string Name { get; set; }
    public bool IsButtonEnabled { get; set; }

    [DataGridViewButtonColumn(nameof(OnButtonClick), nameof(IsButtonEnabled))]
    public string ButtonColumn { get; set; }

    public void OnButtonClick()
    {
        // Handle button click event
        Console.WriteLine($"Button clicked for row with Id: {Id}");
    }
}

// Create an array of DataRow instances
var dataRows = new[]
{
    new DataRow { Id = 1, Name = "Row 1", IsButtonEnabled = true, ButtonColumn = "Click Me" },
    new DataRow { Id = 2, Name = "Row 2", IsButtonEnabled = false, ButtonColumn = "Disabled" }
};

// Create a DataGridView and set its data source
var dataGridView = new DataGridView
{
    DataSource = dataRows
};

// Assume the DataGridViewButtonColumnAttribute is processed and appropriate columns are added
```

#### `DataGridViewCellDisplayTextAttribute`

Specifies a property to be used for the display text of a `DataGridViewCell`.

Inherits `Attribute`.

| `DataGridViewCellDisplayTextAttribute` | `DataGridViewCellDisplayTextAttribute(string propertyName)` | Specifies a property to be used for the display text of a `DataGridViewCell`. |

```csharp
// Define a custom class for the data grid view rows
public class DataRow
{
    public int Id { get; set; }
    public string Name { get; set; }

    [DataGridViewCellDisplayText(nameof(DisplayName))]
    public string DisplayText { get; set; }

    public string DisplayName => $"{Name} (ID: {Id})";
}

// Create an array of DataRow instances
var dataRows = new[]
{
    new DataRow { Id = 1, Name = "Row 1", DisplayText = "Display 1" },
    new DataRow { Id = 2, Name = "Row 2", DisplayText = "Display 2" }
};

// Create a DataGridView and set its data source
var dataGridView = new DataGridView
{
    DataSource = dataRows
};

// Enable extended attributes to recognize the custom attributes
dataGridView.EnableExtendedAttributes();
```

```csharp
    public string Name { get; set; }
    public decimal Value { get; set; }
}

// Create an array of DataRow instances
var dataRows = new[]
{
    new DataRow { Id = 1, Name = "Row 1", Value = 10 },
    new DataRow { Id = 2, Name = "Row 2", Value = 20 }
};

// Create a DataGridView and set its data source
var dataGridView = new DataGridView
{
    DataSource = dataRows
};

// Create a DataGridViewNumericUpDownColumn with static configuration
var numericUpDownColumn = new DataGridViewNumericUpDownColumn
{
    Name = "NumericUpDownColumn",
    HeaderText = "Value",
    DataPropertyName = nameof(DataRow.Value),
    DecimalPlaces = 2,
    Increment = 1,
    Minimum = 0,
    Maximum = 100,
    UseThousandsSeparator = true
};
dataGridView.Columns.Add(numericUpDownColumn);
```

#### `ListItemImageAttribute`

Specifies an image to display next to items in a `ListView`, `ListBox`, or `ComboBox`. This attribute is applied at the class level and provides image configuration for all items.

Inherits `Attribute`.

| Member | Signature | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ListItemImageAttribute` | `ListItemImageAttribute(string imageListPropertyName = null, string imageKeyPropertyName = null, string imageIndexPropertyName = null)` | Specifies an image to display next to items in a `ListView`, `ListBox`, or `ComboBox`. This attribute is applied at the class level and provides image configuration for all items. |

```csharp
// Display status icons next to items
[ListItemImage(imageListPropertyName: nameof(Icons), imageKeyPropertyName: nameof(StatusIcon))]
public class StatusItem {
  public string Name { get; set; }
  public ImageList Icons { get; set; }
  public string StatusIcon { get; set; }  // "success", "warning", "error", etc.
}

// Alternative using image index
[ListItemImage(imageListPropertyName: nameof(Icons), imageIndexPropertyName: nameof(IconIndex))]
public class IndexedItem {
  public string Name { get; set; }
  public ImageList Icons { get; set; }
  public int IconIndex { get; set; }  // 0, 1, 2, etc.
}

// Usage with ListView
listView.EnableExtendedAttributes();
listView.DataSource = items;

// Usage with ListBox
listBox.EnableExtendedAttributes();
listBox.DataSource = items;
```

#### `ListItemStyleAttribute`

Specifies the visual style (ForeColor, BackColor) for items in a `ListView`, `ListBox`, or `ComboBox`. This attribute is applied at the class level and affects the entire item/row.

Inherits `Attribute`.

| Member | Signature | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ListItemStyleAttribute` | `ListItemStyleAttribute(string foreColor = null, string backColor = null, string foreColorPropertyName = null, string backColorPropertyName = null, string conditionalPropertyName = null)` | Specifies the visual style (ForeColor, BackColor) for items in a `ListView`, `ListBox`, or `ComboBox`. This attribute is applied at the class level and affects the entire item/row. |

```csharp
// Apply red text when item is overdue, green when complete
[ListItemStyle(foreColor: "Red", conditionalPropertyName: nameof(IsOverdue))]
[ListItemStyle(foreColor: "Green", conditionalPropertyName: nameof(IsComplete))]
public class TaskItem {
  public string Name { get; set; }
  public bool IsOverdue { get; set; }
  public bool IsComplete { get; set; }
}

// Usage with ListView
listView.EnableExtendedAttributes();
listView.DataSource = tasks;

// Usage with ListBox
listBox.EnableExtendedAttributes();
listBox.DataSource = tasks;

// Usage with ComboBox
comboBox.EnableExtendedAttributes();
comboBox.DataSource = tasks;
```

#### `ListViewColumnAttribute`

Specifies column configuration for properties displayed in a `ListView` in Details view.

Inherits `Attribute`.

| Member | Signature | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ListViewColumnAttribute` | `ListViewColumnAttribute(string headerText = null)` | Specifies column configuration for properties displayed in a `ListView` in Details view. |
| `Alignment` | `HorizontalAlignment Alignment { get; set; }` | Gets or sets the horizontal alignment of the column content. |
| `DisplayIndex` | `int DisplayIndex { get; set; }` | Gets or sets the display index of the column. Use -1 to use the natural order based on property declaration. |
| `Format` | `string Format { get; set; }` | Gets or sets the format string for displaying the value. |
| `HeaderText` | `string HeaderText { get; }` | Gets the text to display in the column header. |
| `Visible` | `bool Visible { get; set; }` | Gets or sets whether the column is visible. |
| `Width` | `int Width { get; set; }` | Gets or sets the width of the column in pixels. Use -1 for auto-size to content, -2 for auto-size to header. |

```csharp
public class Product {
  [ListViewColumn("Product Name", Width = 200)]
  public string Name { get; set; }

  [ListViewColumn("Price", Width = 80, Alignment = HorizontalAlignment.Right)]
  public decimal Price { get; set; }

  [ListViewColumn("Stock", Width = 60, Alignment = HorizontalAlignment.Center)]
  public int Quantity { get; set; }

  [ListViewColumn(Visible = false)]  // Hidden column
  public int InternalId { get; set; }
}

// Usage
listView.EnableExtendedAttributes();
listView.DataSource = products;  // Columns are auto-generated from attributes
```

#### `ListViewColumnColorAttribute`

Specifies column-specific colors for a property in a `ListView`. This attribute allows per-item color deviation from the row-level `ListItemStyleAttribute`.

Inherits `Attribute`.

| Member | Signature | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ListViewColumnColorAttribute` | `ListViewColumnColorAttribute(string foreColor = null, string backColor = null, string foreColorPropertyName = null, string backColorPropertyName = null, string conditionalPropertyName = null)` | Specifies column-specific colors for a property in a `ListView`. This attribute allows per-item color deviation from the row-level `ListItemStyleAttribute`. |

```csharp
// Row is red when overdue, but Status column can be orange when pending
[ListItemStyle(foreColor: "Red", conditionalPropertyName: nameof(IsOverdue))]
public class Task {
  [ListViewColumn("Name")]
  public string Name { get; set; }

  [ListViewColumn("Status")]
  [ListViewColumnColor(foreColor: "Orange", conditionalPropertyName: nameof(IsPending))]
  public string Status { get; set; }

  [ListViewColumn("Priority")]
  [ListViewColumnColor(foreColorPropertyName: nameof(PriorityColor))]
  public string Priority { get; set; }

  public bool IsOverdue { get; set; }
  public bool IsPending { get; set; }
  public Color PriorityColor { get; set; }
}

// Usage
listView.EnableExtendedAttributes();
listView.DataSource = tasks;
```

#### `ListViewRepeatedImageAttribute`

Specifies that a column in a `ListView` should display repeated images based on a numeric value. This is useful for displaying ratings (e.g., stars), progress indicators, or other visual counts.

Inherits `Attribute`.

| Member | Signature | Summary |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `ListViewRepeatedImageAttribute` | `ListViewRepeatedImageAttribute(string imageListPropertyName, string imageKey, int maxCount = 5)` | Specifies that a column in a `ListView` should display repeated images based on a numeric value. This is useful for displaying ratings (e.g., stars), progress indicators, or other visual counts. |

```csharp
public class Product {
  [ListViewColumn("Name")]
  public string Name { get; set; }

  [ListViewColumn("Rating")]
  [ListViewRepeatedImage(nameof(StarImages), "star", MaxCount = 5)]
  public int Rating { get; set; }  // Shows 0-5 stars based on value

  [ListViewColumn("Quality")]
  [ListViewRepeatedImage(nameof(StarImages), "diamond", MaxCount = 3)]
  public int Quality { get; set; }  // Shows 0-3 diamonds

  public ImageList StarImages { get; set; }
}

// Setup ImageList
var imageList = new ImageList { ImageSize = new Size(16, 16) };
imageList.Images.Add("star", Resources.Star);
imageList.Images.Add("diamond", Resources.Diamond);

// Usage
listView.EnableExtendedAttributes();
listView.DataSource = products.Select(p => new Product {
  Name = p.Name,
  Rating = p.Rating,
  Quality = p.Quality,
  StarImages = imageList
});
```

```csharp
var scheduler = new SchedulerControl {
  ViewType = SchedulerViewType.Week,
  CurrentDate = DateTime.Today
};
scheduler.Items.Add(new SchedulerItem {
  Subject = "Meeting",
  Start = DateTime.Today.AddHours(10),
  End = DateTime.Today.AddHours(11),
  Color = Color.Blue
});
scheduler.ItemClicked += (s, e) => Console.WriteLine($"Clicked: {e.Item.Subject}");
```

```csharp
var diagram = new DiagramControl {
  DiagramType = DiagramType.Sankey,
  Title = "Energy Flow"
};
diagram.Nodes.Add(new DiagramNode("A", "Source A"));
diagram.Nodes.Add(new DiagramNode("B", "Target B"));
diagram.SankeyLinks.Add(new DiagramSankeyLink("A", "B", 100));
```

| Value | Numeric | Summary |
